description: This file defines the NodeRuntime class, which manages the core runtime functionalities for a client application connecting to a gateway. It handles gateway connection, reconnection, TLS fingerprint verification, user interface actions, chat sessions, voice interactions, and home canvas state management within an Android/Kotlin environment.

classes.name: NodeRuntime
classes.description: Main class managing the client-side runtime, including connection handling, session management, UI actions, chat, voice, and state synchronization.

methods.name: resolveNodeMainSessionKey
methods.description: Constructs the main session key for node communication based on device ID and optional agent ID.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectAuth
methods.description: Resolves the gateway authentication credentials, considering explicit parameters or stored tokens.

methods.name: shouldConnectOperatorSession
methods.description: Determines if an operator session should be initiated based on authentication info and stored tokens.

methods.name: gatewayTlsProbeFailureMessage
methods.description: Generates an error message based on TLS probe failure reason.

methods.name: isTrustedCanvasActionUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is a trusted source for canvas actions.

methods.name: loadChat
methods.description: Loads a chat session by its session key.

methods.name: refreshChat
methods.description: Refreshes the current chat session.

methods.name: refreshChatSessions
methods.description: Refreshes the list of chat sessions, optionally limited by count.

methods.name: setChatThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets the AI chat’s current thinking level.

methods.name: switchChatSession
methods.description: Switches the active chat session to the specified session key.

methods.name: abortChat
methods.description: Aborts ongoing chat interactions.

methods.name: sendChat
methods.description: Sends a chat message with optional attachments and thinking level.

methods.name: sendChatAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Sends a chat message and waits for acceptance, returning success status.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Dispatches incoming gateway events to relevant handlers.

methods.name: parseChatSendRunId
methods.description: Parses a response to extract the run ID of a chat send request.

methods.name: refreshBrandingFromGateway
methods.description: Requests branding info such as seam color from the gateway.

methods.name: refreshAgentsFromGateway
methods.description: Fetches and updates the list of agents from the gateway.

methods.name: updateHomeCanvasState
methods.description: Updates the home canvas state with current gateway and agent info.

methods.name: makeHomeCanvasPayload
methods.description: Builds the payload data for the home canvas based on current state.

methods.name: resolveHomeCanvasGatewayState
methods.description: Gets current connection state for the home canvas.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentId
methods.description: Determines the current active agent ID based on session info.

methods.name: resolveActiveAgentName
methods.description: Resolves a display name for the active agent.

methods.name: homeCanvasAgents
methods.description: Creates a list of agent cards for the home canvas.

methods.name: homeCanvasBadge
methods.description: Generates a badge (emoji or initials) representing an agent.

methods.name: normalised
methods.description: Normalizes string values (trims, nullifies if empty).

methods.name: triggerCameraFlash
methods.description: Triggers camera flash by updating a token.

methods.name: showCameraHud
methods.description: Displays camera HUD with a message and optional auto-hide timer.
